# Resident Chart — Dorothy Kessler
Room 318-A · DOB 1938-01-30 · Female · Admitted 2022-04-19
Code status: DNR · Allergies: NKDA

## Problem list
- Hypothyroidism (on levothyroxine since 2009)
- Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction
- Osteoporosis (vertebral compression fracture 2024)
- Depression, stable
- Hypertension

## Care plan notes
- Mobility: ambulates independently in the unit, walks to dining room, attends chair yoga twice weekly. No recent change.
- Diet: regular, high-fibre by preference (bran, fruit, vegetables). Eats 75–100% of meals. Fluids 1400–1600 mL/day.
- Bowel: historically regular, soft-formed daily. No bowel regimen.
- Cognition: intact. Reliable historian.

## Recent nursing notes
- Oct 2: Resident mentions she "feels the cold more than usual", requested extra blanket.
- Oct 6: Weight 64.1 kg (was 62.0 kg on Sept 1). Appetite unchanged.
- Oct 9: Sleeping in until 09:30 most days; says she is "just tired". Mood screen unchanged (PHQ-2 = 1).
- Oct 12: Daughter visited; brought a bottle of calcium chews. Resident says she takes two with her morning pills "for her bones". Not on the MAR.
- Oct 15: Reports hard stools and straining for about a week. Declined PRN. Skin dry.

## Labs on file
- TSH 2.1 mIU/L — 2025-08-14 (14 months ago). No thyroid labs since.
- Potassium 4.0, creatinine 78 — 2026-06-10.
- Calcium not checked in the past 12 months.
